title.value: Aperiodic brain activity and response to anesthesia vary in disorders of consciousness
title.justification: The title directly reflects the focus of the paper on aperiodic brain activity and its variation in response to anesthesia in the context of disorders of consciousness.
title.quote: Aperiodic brain activity and response to anesthesia vary in disorders of consciousness

extractions.description: This study investigates the aperiodic EEG component of individuals in a disorder of consciousness and examines how this component changes in response to anesthesia. The research highlights the diagnostic and prognostic potential of the aperiodic EEG component in assessing consciousness levels, especially relevant in cases without oscillatory EEG peaks.
